examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Three questions in one card, the first open. The group reads each item's title for the trigger and renders its body in the panel.

examples.name: Multiple
examples.summary: `type="multiple"` lets the reader keep several answers open to compare them.

examples.name: Markdown
examples.summary: The same group written in a Markdown page: `DocMarkdown` turns an `<AccordionGroup>` with `<Accordion title>` items into `DocAccordionGroup` and `DocAccordion`, so docs authors write the tags and never import the components.
